data.one_liner: Allows zooming and scrolling a ListView or other Scrollables.
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that wraps a ListView or other Scrollables to support both zooming and scrolling. Features include double-tap to zoom, programmatic zoom control, and minimum/maximum scale limits.
use_when: You need to allow users to zoom in and out of a scrolling list of items or images.
You want support for double-tap to zoom and custom gesture handlers on scrollable widgets.
avoid_when: You only need standard scrolling without any zooming capabilities.
You are using unsupported scrollable lists that cannot expose their ScrollPosition.
strengths: Supports double-tap to zoom and double-tap-and-drag gestures.
Provides a ZoomViewController for programmatic zoom control.
weaknesses: Requires manual configuration of controllers across the list and zoom view.
Using alternative scrollable lists like scrollable_positioned_list requires a custom fork or adapter setup.
